Port of Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies for PSVita.
Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies is a mobile game that proposes the popular Zombies mode from Call of Duty: Black Ops.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
